name: plugly-reflect-memory
description: Agent self-improvement + retrieval. Captures learnings via colon-namespaced sub-skills (reflect, plugly-reflect-memory:consolidate, plugly-reflect-memory:ingest, plugly-reflect-memory:recall, plugly-reflect-memory:status) and auto-injects relevant prior learnings via sessionStart/userPromptSubmitted hooks. postToolUse arms low-cost mini-learning capture; agentStop enqueues short-session reflection. Philosophy: Correct once, never again; recall everything next time.
